issues.reason: Premise form for a copular whenever-trigger is unlegislated (every whenever example is eventive) and the flat conjunct is entailed by the reified conjuncts, so the rule asserts nothing false, ill-typed or extra (the binding calibration line) — and the reviewer's firing scenario fails on its own terms, since a KB holding only the flat copular atom could never satisfy the (Time $u night) restriction that requires the reified state anyway.

gaps_confirmed: 'through the night' (a throughout-extent over a day-part) has no licensed carrier: During needs two reified eventualities and a duration Measure needs a stated count, so only (Time $u night) survives and the whole-night extent is lost
new_gaps: how a copular trigger clause renders inside a whenever-rule premise is unspecified — dual-emit is defined for assertions, and a past-tense trigger's flat half is Past-wrapped so a bare flat premise conjunct can never match it; a canonical premise match-form (plausibly the reified state alone) needs legislating
